title: Syrian-Style Chicken Kebabs
description: Juicy chicken kebabs marinated in a blend of Middle Eastern spices, served with a side of fresh vegetables.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemongrass, garlic, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated chicken cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with your choice of sides, such as grilled vegetables or a salad.
Optional: serve with a side of tahini sauce or tzatziki for added flavor.
